messages:
alex: Noticed a persistent mismatch between console session counts and billing on streaming routes. Looks like resume failures + immediate new session creates are double-counting.

mira: Which routes are affected? Any specific client SDK?

alex: Mostly mobile SDKs hitting ws/v2 and ws/legacy. Pattern: client sends resume, origin returns 410/resume-not-found, proxy then opens a fresh session and strips/rewrites resume headers. Console sees both attempts as separate.

sam: Reproduced locally. Minimal script: client sends Resume:abc -> origin 410 -> proxy allocates new session id. Logs:
```
route=ws/v2 resume_id=abc origin=410 proxy_session=ps-789
```

mira: That explains the spike. Quick fix idea: origin keep a short-lived cache of recently-seen resume_ids and skip increment if seen. Make window configurable.

jordan: Careful: quota system expects counts to reflect active sockets. If we dedupe naively, clients might bypass quota by retrying new sessions rapidly. Add a resume_flap_count metric and block circuit if too many resume failures from same tenant.

sam: Implementing dedupe: only increment active_sessions if resume_id not in recent set. Pseudocode:
```
if resume_id:
  if cache.contains(resume_id):
    emit('stream.resume.dedupe')
  else:
    cache.add(resume_id, ttl=dedupe_window)
    increment_active()
else:
  increment_active()
```
Will add `resume_result` tag and `session_origin` header passthrough.

mira: From UX side: console should show both metrics during rollout: active_stream_sessions_old, active_stream_sessions_new, stream.resume.dedupe and resume_flap_count. Alert if dedupe spikes or resume_flap_count > 50/min. Put rollout behind feature flag.

alex: Also want a handshake header like `X-Stream-TTL-ms` so proxy & origin agree on session TTL. Right now proxies infer TTL differently and that causes early expirations.

jordan: Suggest signing resume_id header to prevent proxies from corrupting it. `X-Resume-Sig: HMAC(request_id, secret)` optional behind flag. Avoid default on to reduce ops friction.

sam: PR opened: https://internal/infra/pr/801 includes origin dedupe, `session_origin` telemetry, `resume_result:{ok,410,timeout}`, and unit tests for race: resume-410 then new-session within 200ms.

mira: For canary: 3 pods, dedupe_window default 30s, monitor `active_stream_sessions_v2`, `stream.resume.dedupe`, `quota.charge_mismatch`. We should add a per-namespace override in config.

alex: Add runbook note about "proxy rewriting resume header" and quick ops commands to detect (curl with X-Resume-Id).

sam: I'll also add a chaos test that simulates TLS-terminating proxy that drops custom headers intermittently. Ensures HMAC-sig option helps.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started: streaming-origin v2.8.0 -> 3 pods.

jordan: Watching metrics during canary. If dedupe drops charge delta by >80% and no quota bypass, we can ramp.

mira: I'll prepare console tile and short doc entry in internal docs/streaming-telemetry.md describing new fields and thresholds.

alex: Thanks — once canary passes let's flip feature flag for a subset of namespaces and monitor 1h.

sam: Noted. PR includes instructions: `curl -H \"Upgrade: websocket\" -H \"X-Resume-Id: abc123\" ...` for debug.

jordan: :thumbsup: ping here with canary link.

mira: Reviewing PR now.

alex: Closing loop: make sure billing team is cc'ed on rollout so they can verify charges.

sam: Done. I'll post canary dashboard link shortly.

jordan: No anomalies so far at +10min.

mira: Great, keep an eye on `resume_flap_count` and `stream.resume.dedupe`.

alex: Thanks everyone.
